LESSON: AFRICAN DIASPORAS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Political Development and Governance
Topic 5.4: African Diasporas
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers African Diasporas, part of Political Development and Governance in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we promote collaboration between continental Africans and African Diasporas? 2. How can we promote African Unity in the society today?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on African Diasporas together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to Learn: Learners reflects on their experiences as they carry out research/investigation as they use library

resources to research on the factors that contributed to the movement of African diasporas to various parts of the world.

Values:
● Social Justice: Learners demonstrate cooperation as they watch or listen to a video or You- Tube on the role of diaspora

in the political development in Africa.

● Patriotism: Learners apply democracy and rule of law as they debate on the role of diaspora in the political development

in Africa.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Creative Thinking: Learners participate in creative games using digital devices with assistive technology to indicate on

the world map countries inhabited by African diasporas.

● Social Cohesion: Learners respects others views/feelings as they debate on the role of diaspora in the political

development in Africa.

Link to other subjects:

● Pre- technical and Business studies: Learners view a video or You- Tube on the role of diaspora in the political

development in Africa.

77

Suggested Learning Resources:

Resource persons, digital resources with assistive technology, approved textbooks and other printed or braille

resources, embossed/ tactile charts, internet, flip charts/manilla papers, masking tapes and marker pens/pencils.
